name: agent-pivot
description: Switch, monitor, and resume Codex, Claude, and Kimi sessions across VS Code workspaces.

agentPivot.projectData.markdownDescription: Stores the Agent Pivot data if the ```agentPivot.storeProjectsInSettings``` option is set to ```true```. The raw data can be edited by using the command ```Agent Pivot: Edit Projects```.

agentPivot.projectSyncData.markdownDescription: Versioned Agent Pivot sync metadata. Use Agent Pivot commands to edit projects.

agentPivot.todoData.markdownDescription: Stores the global Agent Pivot TODO list if the ```agentPivot.storeProjectsInSettings``` option is set to ```true```.

agentPivot.promptData.markdownDescription: Legacy Prompt library storage. Agent Pivot migrates this value into synchronized extension state. Do not store credentials or other secrets in Prompts.
agentPivot.promptData.deprecationMessage: Prompt data is now stored in synchronized Agent Pivot extension state. This setting is retained only for migration.

agentPivot.customCss.markdownDescription: Custom CSS rules to be injected into the Agent Pivot can be placed here. Note that this will not be sanitized!

agentPivot.recentColors.markdownDescription: Stores the recently used colors if the ```agentPivot.storeProjectsInSettings``` option is set to ```true```.

agentPivot.storeProjectsInSettings.markdownDescription: If set to ```true```, the Agent Pivot data is saved in the user settings and can be synced using the ```Settings Sync``` extension to multiple devices. NOTE: This disables the possibility of having varying Agent Pivot data on these devices. **(VSCode restart required)**

agentPivot.maxVisibleAiSessions.markdownDescription: Maximum number of AI session rows visible in an expanded project card before the session list scrolls.

agentPivot.aiConversation.showThinking.description: Show provider Thinking content in AI Conversation for Kimi, Claude, and Codex.

agentPivot.aiSessionTerminalMode.description: Choose whether new AI sessions run in VS Code terminals or managed tmux sessions. tmux preserves a process only while its execution host remains awake and running.

agentPivot.aiSessionYoloMode.description: Bypass provider approval and sandbox protections for newly created and resumed AI session processes. This is dangerous and does not change already running sessions.

enumDescriptions: Group AI sessions as windows in one managed tmux session per project.
Run every AI session in its own managed tmux session.
agentPivot.aiSessionTmuxLayout.description: Choose how managed tmux sessions are organized.

agentPivot.aiSessionTmuxPath.description: Executable name resolved through the current extension host's PATH, or an absolute executable path. Enter one executable only, without additional tmux arguments or a shell command.

enumDescriptions: Electric currents flow along the top and bottom card edges.
A diagonal light beam sweeps across the card periodically.
A glowing dot with a comet tail orbits along the card edge.
A rotating glowing halo surrounds the project kind icon.
Sonar ripples expand from the project kind icon.
The whole card glow breathes softly.
Your own image (agentPivot.aiSessionRunningCardCustomImage) replaces and rotates over the project kind icon.
No animation; only a static tinted border.
agentPivot.aiSessionRunningCardAnimation.description: Animation shown on a workspace card while one or more AI sessions are executing. OTHER WINDOWS uses only its existing aggregate running state and does not expose provider or session identities.

agentPivot.aiSessionRunningCardCustomIma.markdownDescription: Local image file (absolute path or starting with `~`; SVG, PNG, GIF, WebP, or JPEG up to 256 KB) shown when `agentPivot.aiSessionRunningCardAnimation` is `custom`. The file never leaves your machine. Changes to this setting apply immediately; after replacing the file in place, run `Developer: Reload Window` to pick up the new bytes.

enumDescriptions: A rotating blue border surrounds the running Active Session terminal icon.
A bright rotating halo surrounds the running Active Session terminal icon.
Your own image (agentPivot.aiSessionRunningIconCustomImage) replaces and rotates over the running Active Session icon.
No animation; show the ordinary circular terminal icon.
agentPivot.aiSessionRunningIconAnimation.description: Animation shown on the icon of an Active Session row while that session is executing.

agentPivot.aiSessionRunningIconCustomIma.markdownDescription: Local image file (absolute path or starting with `~`; SVG, PNG, GIF, WebP, or JPEG up to 256 KB) shown when `agentPivot.aiSessionRunningIconAnimation` is `custom`. The file never leaves your machine. Changes to this setting apply immediately; after replacing the file in place, run `Developer: Reload Window` to pick up the new bytes.

agentPivot.maxVisibleTodosPerGroup.markdownDescription: Maximum number of TODO cards visible in each group before the group list scrolls.

agentPivot.maxVisibleProjectsPerGroup.markdownDescription: Maximum number of project cards visible in each group on the Projects tab before the group list scrolls.

agentPivot.aiSessionAttention.enabled.description: Show attention indicators when Agent Pivot AI sessions finish or may need input.

agentPivot.notify.enabled.markdownDescription: Send a notification to an IM or push service when an AI session stops and needs you. Sends project name, session name and status to the endpoints you configure.

agentPivot.notify.sinks.markdownDescription: Notification targets without credentials. Both halves of a sink are normally written for you by `Agent Pivot: Set Notification Webhook`; edit this array only to tune or remove targets. Channels that can also receive replies in a future release: `ntfy`, `telegram`, `slack`, `discord`, `dingtalk`, `feishu`. Only `ntfy` broadcasts to every machine; the others deliver a reply to one machine at random.

agentPivot.notify.reasons.markdownDescription: Which stop reasons trigger a notification. `failed` is only produced by Claude sessions.

agentPivot.notify.minRunDurationMs.markdownDescription: Skip notifications for sessions that ran shorter than this. Raise it if short turns are too chatty.

agentPivot.notify.projectPathMode.markdownDescription: Whether notifications carry the project folder name only, or its full path.

agentPivot.notify.includeSessionLabel.markdownDescription: Include the session title. Turn off to send only the short correlation code.

agentPivot.notify.proxy.markdownDescription: Proxy for notification requests, for example `http://127.0.0.1:7890`. Empty falls back to `HTTPS_PROXY` / `ALL_PROXY`.

agentPivot.skills.globalStorePath.markdownDescription: Location of the Global Skills store. Use `~` or an absolute path. Agent Pivot can safely move existing skills when this changes. Project Skills remain in each project's `.skills` folder.

agentPivot.openOnStartup.markdownDescription: Note: The ```empty workspace``` option takes only effect if [Workbench: Startup Editor](#workbench.startupEditor) is to ```none``` or a ```welcomePage``` option.

agentPivot.showAddGroupButtonTile.markdownDescription: If set to ```false```, the '+ New Group' tile is hidden. Groups can be added by using the Command Palette (default ```F1```) with 'Agent Pivot: Add Group' action. The Agent Pivot needs to be refreshed for the changes to take effect.

agentPivot.applyProjectColorToWindow.markdownDescription: If set to ```true```, Agent Pivot applies the saved project color to the current VS Code window by writing workspace ```workbench.colorCustomizations``` values for title bar, activity bar, and status bar.
